alternate_mechanisms.name: hidden_ecology_of_unseen_provision
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Forenoon, settled night, cloud, collected water, nourishment, poverty, enrichment, and favor form a material analogue of hidden care becoming visible provision. Weather, pasture, and livestock remain underlays rather than surface events.

alternate_mechanisms.name: speech_keeps_need_open
alternate_mechanisms.summary: A petition makes need communicable. Rebuke closes access, while dialogue, answer, practical support, sufficiency, and truthful narration keep the relation open and permit favor to circulate.

alternate_mechanisms.name: collective_stewardship_from_received_care
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Entrusted care received in vulnerability becomes governance of one's conduct toward a wider social body. Custody, foster care, repair, dependent support, and asylum turn private reassurance into collective responsibility.

alternate_mechanisms.name: good_is_not_reducible_to_wealth
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Wealth may be called good, but the surah defines superior good through giving that answers poverty, supports dependents, and extends favor. Material sufficiency is one carrier of good, not its exhaustive meaning.

alternate_mechanisms.name: settled_disposition_becomes_public_ethic
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The stillness of the opening can be internalized as stable character. Reassurance then yields chosen good, composed guidance, refusal of domination and rebuke, and narration that renews moral attention.

alternate_mechanisms.name: shelter_matures_into_habitable_belonging
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Attentive and compassionate finding answers exposed singleness first with shelter, then with abiding guardianship, stable dwelling, and a place suited to continued life. Belonging is the matured spatial form of care.

alternate_mechanisms.name: future_promise_as_repair_and_governance
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The first phase is not merely replaced by a later one. Nurture, discernment, promised giving, and restored satisfaction set earlier vulnerability into a repaired order whose ethical consequences must be governed in the present.

alternate_mechanisms.name: voiced_favor_without_performance_claim
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Sufficiency becomes audible acknowledgment: favor is praised, affirmed, extended, discussed, and disclosed. Vocal form is preserved as an underlay, without inferring song, poetry, or ritual performance.
